summary: Full backend + frontend test of GridLink SL communicator. Backend: 13/13 pytest tests passed including real XML-RPC login to login.agni.lindenlab.com returning 401 (grid reached, creds rejected as expected). Diagnostics endpoint reaches Agni grid with dns_ok=true, reachable=true, latency_ms populated (~689ms). Frontend: OFFLINE login → tabs works; Chat Local send+echo verified; Friends tab shows 5 seeded friends with online dots and All/Online filter; Inventory shows nested folder tree with per-type icons and expand chevron; More tab shows session card and Diagnostics/Radar/Settings/Disconnect rows; Diagnostics screen renders latency gauge/DNS/TCP/endpoint card for agni; Disconnect returns to login screen.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 557-line file - acceptable for now but consider splitting login/chat/diagnostics into modules if it grows.
Bottom tab icons don't expose explicit tab-* testIDs (Expo Router uses labels). Not blocking, but adding testID='tab-chat' etc. would help future automation.
seed_data_creation: Offline login seeds 5 friends + 12 inventory folders per session. All test sessions cleaned up via /api/logout in fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Grid login test uses fake credentials and expects 401 from real Linden Lab server = success. Offline mode is the default for UI tests to avoid real SL creds.
